title: Run your whole company from one place
description: An executive assistant for the grunt work: meetings captured, inbox sorted, customers found, and candidates sourced. Free to download.
introduction: As a founder you're head of sales, head of recruiting, head of fundraising, and the person who fixes the printer. Most days you'd give a lot for an executive assistant who could take the grunt work off your hands.

Strawberry can be that assistant. It's a free browser with an AI companion built in, working in your inbox, calendar, and every web app you use. And because every conversation can go into your team workspace, it gets sharper at your company over time.

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Strawberry is free to download. Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

sections.title: Transcribe every meeting, build a company brain

blocks.text: One-on-ones, sales calls, candidate calls, investor and press conversations. Strawberry transcribes them without a bot in the room, and each one adds to what your companions know about the company and how to talk about it.

demo.title: Investor update call
lines: You: Revenue grew 40% since the seed.
Maria: What is the plan for the US?
You: A first hire in New York this spring.
outcomes: Notes saved to the team workspace
US hiring plan added to the board doc

sections.title: Wake up to a sorted inbox

blocks.text: A morning Routine labels your mail the way you like, archives the junk, and tells you the three messages that actually need you.

items.context: Set up a morning Routine that sorts your inbox.

blocks.text: Tell Strawberry who your best customers are and it finds more like them, each with a reason and a source. Then it drafts outreach that sounds like you.

demo.prompt: Find 10 companies like our three best customers

items.context: Find companies like your best customers, each with a reason it fits.

sections.title: Source candidates like your best people

blocks.text: Describe someone great on your team. Strawberry turns that into a scorecard, shows you a few mock candidates to calibrate, then searches LinkedIn, GitHub, and the open web for real ones.

demo.prompt: Find engineers like Sara, our best backend hire
steps: Built a scorecard from Sara's profile

sections.title: Write posts in your own voice

blocks.text: The best material for your posts is what you've already said out loud. Strawberry drafts from your meetings and past writing, and generates images when they help.

demo.prompt: Turn what I said on today's investor call into a LinkedIn post
steps: Matching the tone of your last 20 posts

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: ChatGPT and Claude are great to think with. But the work itself happens in your inbox, your CRM, and on LinkedIn, and that's where Strawberry works.

items: It uses your logged-in apps directly, with no exports or copy and paste.
It works across many tabs at once, not one click at a time.
Everything it learns can be shared with your team, so the context outlives any one chat.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Review contracts, decks, and specs, with questions and suggested edits.
Prepare a fundraise: investors who back similar companies, a target list, updates, and the deck.
Get a daily brief of meetings, open threads, and what changed.
Turn research into a beautiful deck.

blocks.text: Everything you teach Strawberry stays with the company, not just with you. Keep a shared companion in the team workspace, and every teammate works with how you sell, hire, and talk about the business.
When you hand over an area, hand over the companion too. The new person starts with months of context on day one.
